subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should unpinned GitHub Copilot Responses models automatically replace managed web search when native support is only inferred from generic catalog metadata?
rationale: The choice changes default provider routing and failure behavior, while the inspected code and dependency contracts do not establish a hosted-search-specific Copilot availability signal for every account and model.

options.title: Require verified eligibility
options.body: Use an authoritative hosted-search capability or narrow live-tested allowlist and preserve managed search for unknown availability.

options.title: Accept inferred eligibility
options.body: Allow generic Responses and tool-call metadata to trigger native search and intentionally accept unsupported-tool failures for some setups.

options.title: Keep managed search default
options.body: Defer automatic native routing until Copilot exposes a stable machine-readable hosted-search capability.

recommendation.title: Require verified eligibility
recommendation.body: Use an authoritative hosted-search capability or narrow live-tested allowlist and preserve managed search for unknown availability.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work owns the affected per-account Copilot catalog and provider sign-in paths.
